issues.problem: Context 6 (你有话就开门见山地说，别让我猜了) is about frankness in general; 实话实说 from the same set fits the braces almost as well.
issues.action: Rewrote it around skipping the preamble (别铺垫那么多了……), so getting to the point, not truthfulness, is what the slot calls for. The story (严羽《沧浪诗话·诗评》: 太白发句，谓之开门见山) was checked and kept.

issues.problem: In context 3 the English 'whispered sweet nothings' adds whispering, which the Chinese 对我说 does not say.
issues.action: Changed the English to 'he said sweet things to me every day'.
